column1: # Third-party browser dependencies, snapshotted into the webapp image.
# Columns:  dest<TAB>sha384<TAB>url
#   dest    path under /usr/share/nginx/html/vendor/
#   sha384  base64 Subresource Integrity digest, or "-" to skip verification
#   url     upstream, fetched ONCE at image build time
# The digests below are copied verbatim from the geo-agent template's
# index.html and from geo-agent's own source (chart-renderer.js, map-draw.js),
# which is where these libraries are pinned upstream. They are the whole point
# of this file: an offline bundle can only be trusted if the bytes that went
# into it were verified at the moment they left the network. Once the image is
# built, everything is same-origin and SRI attributes stop carrying meaning —
# so the trust boundary is HERE, at fetch time, not in the served HTML.
# Bumping a version means replacing BOTH the URL and its digest. fetch.sh
# refuses to proceed on a mismatch; never "fix" a failure by setting "-".
maplibre-gl/maplibre-gl.js
maplibre-gl/maplibre-gl.css
pmtiles/pmtiles.js
h3-js/h3-js.umd.js
marked/marked.umd.js
dompurify/purify.min.js
highlight/github-dark.min.css
highlight/highlight.min.js
highlight/sql.min.js
# ── Lazy-loaded by geo-agent at runtime ──────────────────────────────────────
# These are the easy ones to miss. Nothing fetches them on page load; they
# appear minutes later the first time a user asks for a chart or opens the
# draw tool. An offline bundle that skips them looks perfectly healthy right
# up until someone says "plot that as a bar chart".
# All four digests are geo-agent's own, lifted from the constants beside each
# URL in chart-renderer.js (D3_JS_SRI, PLOT_JS_SRI) and map-draw.js
# (DRAW_JS_SRI, DRAW_CSS_SRI).
d3/d3.min.js
plot/plot.umd.min.js
mapbox-gl-draw/mapbox-gl-draw.js
mapbox-gl-draw/mapbox-gl-draw.css

# layers-input.json because both of its backends (Nominatim, Photon) are
# remote services with no offline equivalent — shipping the widget without a
# backend would just be a search box that always fails.
